Leading Green Steel manufacturing company of North India.
MaXXon is a leading Green Steel manufacturing company based in Mandi Gobindgarh, Punjab — one of North India's largest steel manufacturing hubs. As a dedicated TMT bar and steel pipe manufacturer, we are committed to quality, innovation, and integrity in every bar and pipe we produce.Our TMT bars and MS steel pipes are engineered to Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) specifications and tested for maximum durability, flexibility, and earthquake resistance. By combining experienced manufacturing staff, modern testing equipment, and a customer-first approach, Maxxon has built a reputation as a reliable TMT bar and steel pipe supplier to dealers, contractors, and builders across North India.

Frequently Asked Questions
Why is Maxxon considered one of the best TMT bar manufacturers in North India?
Maxxon is a BIS (ISI) and ISO-certified TMT bar manufacturer based in Mandi Gobindgarh, serving builders, dealers, and contractors across Punjab, Haryana, Delhi NCR, Himachal Pradesh, Gujarat, and Jammu & Kashmir. Its TMT bars are BIS (ISI) certified and manufactured under an ISO-certified process using Germany-designed TurboQuench Technology, ensuring high strength, durability, and consistent quality for construction projects.
Does Maxxon manufacture steel pipes as well as TMT bars?
Yes. Maxxon manufactures both TMT bars and 
MS steel pipes
 from its Green Steel manufacturing facility, with both product lines tested to Bureau of Indian Standards specifications.
What certifications does Maxxon hold?
Maxxon’s TMT bars are BIS (ISI) certified and produced under an ISO-certified manufacturing process, using Germany-designed TurboQuench Technology
Where is Maxxon's manufacturing plant located?
Maxxon’s main plant is located on G.T. Road, Sirhind Side, Mandi Gobindgarh, Punjab — one of North India’s major steel manufacturing hubs.
